description: Martinsville, VA — Joy Powers, Democratic nominee for Congress in Virginia’s Ninth District, will hold an in-person town hall in Martinsville on Tuesday, September 22, giving residents the opportunity to speak directly with Powers and ask questions about the issues facing their families and communities.The town hall will be held from 6:00 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. at the Virginia Museum of Natural History, located at 21 Starling Ave, Martinsville, VA 24112.“Representation means more than asking for some
